d:
Jensen Huang may have stepped down from Nvidia, but the battle over his future is far from over. His supporters are mobilising, thousands have signed a petition demanding his return, and a Silicon Valley group is reportedly preparing a campaign to bring him back.
But Washington has a different plan. US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent wants a dramatic shake-up, while lawmakers are demanding answers over allegations that restricted Nvidia chips reached China. Who will have the final say? Palki Sharma tells you.
